trans: v. stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something; prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening

name: background

n. a person who owes allegiance to that nation

name: international
trans: adj. concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations; from or between other countries

name: seem
trans: v. give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect; seem to be true, probable, or apparent

name: listener
trans: n. someone who listens attentively

name: in person

name: part-time
trans: adj. involving less than the standard or customary time for an activity

name: article
trans: n. nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication; one of a class of artifacts

name: studio

name: purpose
